instruction.instruction_text: Walk to the end of the table. Turn right and walk through the doorway. Turn right again and walk past the stove. Turn right once more and walk past the fridge. Stop between the small sink on the left and the shelves on the right.
Take a right at the big clock, walk straight through the kitchen, when you see the thermostat on the wall you are next to the bathroom.
Walk between the two counters in the kitchen. Walk through the small room off the kitchen. Turn right after exiting that room. Take the next right into the bedroom. Stop at the bed.
Walk out of the bathroom and turn left. Turn left at the big clock on the wall. Walk into the bedroom and wait next to the bed.
Walk up stairs for about 10 steps. Walk straight across landing through open doorway. Stop once inside.
Walk through the dining room and go to the other end. Go through the double doors on the right. Walk straight across the hallway and wait outside by the rug.
Go straight, take a left at the end of the hall stop next to the door before the bedroom.
Walk down the hall to the right of the phone. Turn left and walk past the table with the red tablecloth. Stop at the next intersection.
Turn right and enter the hallway between the two doors.
Walk past the outside area on your right and walk towards the dining room. Walk past the dining table and walk through three doorways and wait near the fourth doorway.

Walk out of the bedroom and straight down the hall. Turn left at the end of the hall and go into the hall with the gray wall. Turn right into the hall with the gray wall and wait next to the table closest to you.
Go through the arch with the mosaic floor into the room. Go through the next arch on the right by the stairs. Go straight through the door with the tile floor into the bedroom with the red comforter.
Walk past the kitchen towards the couch. Turn right and walk into the fitness room. Stop next to the treadmill.
Walk through the breakfast nook and past the kitchen. Pass the thermostat and stop at the exercise ball.
Go in the doorway and take a left at the second opening. Stop just before the plant on the right.
Walk past the fireplace keeping it on your left. Walk down the hall and stop once you reach the doorway.
Walk past the white couch on the left. Walk through the arch and past the round table. Stop next to the long table.

Go inside the room with the bathtub on your right. Turn right and stand just before the bar. Turn left and climb the stairs. At the top take the first door on the right and wait in front of the table.
Turn right and walk down the hall until you get to the last door on the right. Go through those double doors and wait inside.
Walk out of the dining room and into the living room. Turn right into the game room. Stop between the door and the pool table.
Walk down hallway with railing on your right. In the bedroom take a right into the bathroom and wait next to the toilet.
Walk straight ahead for 0 feet until you get to a picture hanging on the wall.
Walk out of the fitness room and take a left. Walk past the kitchen and once you exit the kitchen turn left and walk across the tile floor.
Walk to the right through the doorway. Walk straight towards the fireplace. Stop next to the fireplace.
Turn left and walk down the hallway towards the stairs. Turn right and walk past the wine fridge stopping in the kitchen with the wine fridge on your left.
Walk straight into the dining room. Go to the doorway on the right of the wall straight ahead. Wait in the doorway.
Take a left and exit the closet. Go forward towards the bedroom. Take a left into the bedroom. Go straight towards the bathroom. Take a left into the bathroom.
Walk straight then turn left. Stop under the hanging light.

Walk past the desk and out the black door on the far side of the room into the hallway. Turn right and walk down the hallway passing the baskets and plants on your left. Walk up the first flight of stairs stopping outside the doorway of the house.
Walk straight through the dining room and go towards the table with the red tablecloth on the right. Walk past it and into the hall. Stop next to the first roped off area on the right.
Turn around and leave the room. Walk down the hall and take the first flight of stairs down. Go past the rug on the landing and take the next flight of stairs all the way down to the bottom.
Turn left and walk past the couch and ottoman. Turn right into the hallway and walk down the hall towards the kitchen. Stop next to the table in the dining area.
Walk down the hallway passing the two beds and the bathroom entrance on your right. Walk down the hall and stop next to the wood cabinet.
Walk up stairs to top landing near mirror and stop.
Walk straight ahead for 0 feet, then turn right and walk down the long hall towards the big statue of a man.
Walk past the stove on your right. Walk towards the TV on the left. Turn left and go out the glass doors on the left.
Walk forward passing the window and the curtain to exit the room. Walk straight passing all the picture frames on the wall until you reach the middle point with no walls on either side. Stop here.
Leave the room and turn left. Go through the door on the left and wait at the entrance.
Leave the bathroom and go into the closet. Turn left before the bed. Go out of the bedroom and take a right. Walk into the bedroom with the open door on the right and wait at the entrance.
Walk up stairs outside of living area and through sliding glass doors. Walk past TV on the right and into the kitchen. Stop between the kitchen island and pantry.
Leave the bathroom and turn left. Walk past the white rug and enter the bedroom on the left. Stop next to the nightstand with the round clock and the lamp.
Walk straight ahead on the red carpet for about 3 feet until you get past the fire extinguisher.
Go up the stairs to the next floor. Enter the first room on the right and stop just past the doorway.
Walk up stairs to second step. Turn right and enter room. Stand on rug with door on left.
Walk out of the bathroom and down the hall. Turn right at the end of the hallway. Walk past the piano on your left. Stop under the large light fixture over the violin.
Walk toward the house and go through the sliding glass doors. Turn right and stop in the dining room.
Walk past the bathroom on your left. Walk into the room next to it and wait near the doorway.
Walk down the stairs to the first landing. Go through the doorway on the right. Stop in the bathroom once inside.

Walk across the room to the other side of the table. Go through the two little wood doors straight ahead. Turn left after exiting the room and walk down the hall. Turn right at the kitchen entrance before the ovens.
Stand in the doorway between the living area and the big silver thing in the kitchen.
Leave the bedroom and go straight. Go past the kitchen island and turn right. Go into the pantry and stop near the sink.
Walk straight and take a right into the room with the sink. Walk straight and go through the archway on the left. Turn left and go through the doorway.
Walk through the TV room. Go out the door on the left. Stop next to the doorway.
Turn left and enter the bedroom. Turn left and walk past the white rug into the bathroom. Stop at the sink.
Walk down the stairs. Go down three flights of stairs. Stop at the bottom.
Turn around and walk up the hallway. Turn right once you enter the kitchen. Stop at the island.
Walk out of the kitchen and go straight. Walk towards the second door on the right and stop once you are even with it.
Walk along the side of the pool closest to the bar. Stop when you get to the bar.
Walk through the kitchen towards the living room. Stop next to the table behind the couch.
Turn right and exit the bathroom. Go down the hall past the wine cellar on the left. Turn right at the next hallway. Go all the way to the end and turn left. Stop at the bottom step of the stairs.

Exit the sewing room. Turn right. Go towards the glass case with the dolls next to it. Turn right through the doorway. Pass the bed on your left and go into the next room on the left. Stop at the sink.
Turn around and go towards the door on the left. Go down the hall all the way to the end and turn right. Stop once you enter the room.
Walk up stairs. Wait at top.
Walk towards the door on your right. Turn right and wait next to the left side of the small chair on the couch.
Walk straight then turn left. Walk past three chairs on the right and stop next to the fourth chair.
Walk past the bed and up the stairs. Stop at the doorway on the left once you get upstairs.
Walk to the left of the pool and go towards the stairs. Walk up the stairs and make the first right at the top. Wait near the massage table.
Go straight through the doorway and down the hallway. Stop at the last door on the left and wait near the kitchen appliances.
Go through the double doors and walk down the hallway with the red carpet. Stop before going through the next doorway.
Turn right and walk past the four chairs on your left. Turn left and wait near the entrance.
Turn around and go through the doorway. Turn right and go down the hall. Stop at the table before the dining room entrance.
Go up the stairs and turn left. Walk past the fake plant on the right to the bottom of the stairs. Go up the stairs to the top.
Go towards the stove in the kitchen. Go into the next room and stop at the dinning room table.
Walk through the kitchen from the sitting room. Turn left and go into the pantry. Stop after passing the arch.
Turn around and go out of the kitchen. Go through the pantry and down the hall. Go past the closet double doors into the bedroom. Stop before the bed.
Walk past the stairs on the left and stop at the entrance to the dining room.
Walk out of the room and through the doorway on the right. Walk down the hall and enter the room on the left. Turn right and stop in front of the animal head on the wall.
Leave the room going straight. Turn right at the big black bookcase. Turn right into the bedroom at the end of the hall. Wait at the doorway.
Walk past the mirrors on both sides of the hallway and enter the bedroom. Turn left and then turn left again into the bathroom. Stop next to the shower.
Walk to the other side of the bed and stop next to the white bear rug on the floor.
Take a left to walk past the curio cabinet. Go toward the kitchen. Stop at the light switches on the stone wall before the kitchen island with the sink.
Go straight through the double doors. Walk past the table with the hanging light made of glass. Go through the next set of double doors on the right past the wooden cabinet.
Walk up stairs. Turn left and walk through glass entry doors. Wait at entrance.
Walk past the pool table and take a left. Walk past the bar and stop at the base of the stairs.
Walk out of the bedroom and walk towards the door on the right. Stop once you exit the bedroom.

Walk to the right of the large table under the light. Walk across the red rug towards the first doorway you see after passing the table. There will be some red chairs near the doorway. Enter the hallway and wait in the first doorway on the right.
Walk past the couch and coffee table on your left. Walk towards the pool table. Stop next to the window.
Turn left and go around the corner to the other side of the room. Stop once you reach the wall.
Go through the doorway to the right of the big painting. Go straight down the hallway and stop at the double doors.
Take a left at the first doorway. Walk down the hall and stop at the next doorway.
Walk down the red carpet towards the doorway of the next room.
Walk through the hallway next to the four glass doors. Turn left after the kitchen and walk towards the dining room stopping at the doorway where the wood floor turns into carpet.
Turn around and go down the hall next to the stairs. Go straight towards the kitchen. Wait near the two big doors.
Walk past the table and turn left. Walk past the stove and turn right. Go through the doorway and turn left. Climb up to the second step.
Take a left. Turn right at the glass doors. Wait next to the table with the book bag and hat on it.
Walk straight. Go past the couch. Stop at the table with chairs on the right.
Walk out of the closet and turn right. Walk down the hall and turn right through the double doors. Wait near the sink.

Turn left when you leave the room and walk down the hall to the exit. Go straight through the doorway and up the stairs. When you get to the top turn right and enter the bathroom next to the chairs on the left.
Walk up stairs, go between table and couch, go through all 3 doors on right, walk across main living area, walk up stairs and stop on first step.
Take a left and enter the room on the left. Go straight across the room and take a left into the next room. Stop once you reach the white rug.
